item.title: California Embedded Battery Recycling Fee Kicks in January 1, 2026
item.description: Starting January 1, 2026, retailers of covered battery-embedded (CBE) products in California must charge consumers a CBE Waste Recycling Fee at point of purchase or cover the costs of the fee themselves. Per regulations finalized last week, the fee will be 1.5% (capped at $15) of the retail sales price of a CBE product. item.title: CFTC May Gain Primary Authority Over Digital Commodities Under Senate Draft Bill
item.description: On November 10, 2025, Senator John Boozman and Senator Cory Booker released a bipartisan Senate Agriculture Committee discussion draft bill that proposes a new authority for the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) for the exclusive oversight over “digital commodities” traded in spot markets. item.title: California Court Addresses Class Certification, PAGA, and Preemption in Trucking Litigation
item.description: On December 11, 2025, the California Court of Appeal, Third Appellate District, issued a partially published decision in Dieves v. Butte Sand Trucking Company involving a truck driver’s claims against his former employers for alleged violations of California labor law. item.title: Benefits Basics – When an Employee Gets Divorced: A Resource Guide for HR & Benefits Professionals
item.description: While America’s divorce rate has generally been declining over recent years, over 1.8 million Americans still divorce each year. Divorce is one of the most complex and stressful life events your employees may face, affecting not only their home life, but potentially causing significant changes or disruptions at work. item.title: New SEC Cybersecurity Rules Begin to Take Effect
item.description: On May 16, 2024, the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) unanimously approved amendments to Regulation S-P, which imposes new rules relating to cybersecurity breaches involving investment advisers and broker-dealers. item.title: Proposed Rule Eliminates Medicare Part D Notice for ICHRAs

item.title: Connected Vehicle AI: Goldmine or Compliance Minefield?
item.description: For more than a century, value in the automotive sector was defined by engineering and manufacturing excellence. Today, vehicle-generated data is a strategic asset in its own right. item.title: Why Every Health Care Organization Needs Accurate, Up-to-Date Contracts
item.description: In today’s highly regulated healthcare industry, hospitals and medical practices depend on a complex network of contracts including vendor agreements, medical director agreements, time-share and space leases, joint venture agreements, payer contracts, and more.
